svg.aria-label: Kubestack runs on one node: LAN clients resolve *.home.arpa through Pi-hole to Traefik, internet visitors reach trix through a Cloudflare tunnel, Prometheus, OTel collectors feed Cortex, Tempo and Loki, and everything persists on Rook-Ceph on a dedicated SSD.
